# AI bill of materials

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py. Do not edit by hand; run the script. -->

Every model, prompt, agent control, tool, service and runtime dependency of the current tag, generated from the code and configuration. EY's paper on AI use case management screens the risks of agentic AI with an AI bill of materials that includes agentic control factors; this is Bidwright's. [`governance.md`](governance.md) explains how it is used.

## Agentic control factors

| Agent or function | Kind | Tools it may call | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| `triage` | function | None | 1 call and 1 repair, fixed in code |
| `brief` | function | None | 1 call and 1 repair, fixed in code |
| `discover` | agent | `ask_research`, `start_research` | max_turns 4, max_tool_calls 8, stop_on_no_progress True |
| `extract` | function | None | 1 call and 1 repair, fixed in code |
| `approach` | function | None | 1 call and 1 repair, fixed in code |
| `risk` | agent | `search_rfp`, `date_calc` | max_turns 4, max_tool_calls 6, stop_on_no_progress True |
| `decide` | agent | `search_capabilities`, `search_rfp`, `read_section`, `ask_research` | max_turns 4, max_tool_calls 6, stop_on_no_progress True |
| `assess` | function | None | 1 call and 1 repair, fixed in code |
| `draft` | function | None | 1 call and 1 repair, fixed in code |
| `consolidate` | function | None | 1 call and 1 repair, fixed in code |

Controls on every run, in code:

- Every tool call passes `ToolGateway`'s rules, in this order: allowlist, G2 bound ids, argument schema, repeats, call cap, G4 pinned server, G1 job limit, G5 question cap, G3 outbound overlap (`docs/agents.md`).
- Every model response must parse into its Pydantic schema, and code checks every quote against the RFP before a requirement is accepted.
- Per-run limits on requests, tokens and active time, checked before every provider attempt (`config/limits.yaml`).
- Mode `DRAFT_ONLY`: nothing is submitted, and every output is `UNREVIEWED_DRAFT` until a person signs it off.
- Spans and the ledger carry hashes, counts, timings and costs, never prompt or response text.

## Tools

| Tool | Access | Called by |
|---|---|---|
| `search_rfp` | Reads the run's own search index of the RFP; writes nothing | `risk`, `decide` |
| `date_calc` | Computes dates; reads and writes nothing | `risk` |
| `ask_research` | For `discover`, reads the selected research pack, or sends one question to the NotebookLM notebook code bound, and records each answer in `research.json`; for `decide`, reads only the research the run already holds, and writes nothing | `discover`, `decide` |
| `start_research` | Sends one query, built from the research envelope, to NotebookLM as a deep research job on a notebook code created; `discover` writes the job to `research.json` | `discover` |
| `search_capabilities` | Reads the run's own index of the supplier's knowledge base; writes nothing | `decide` |
| `read_section` | Reads one section of the run's passages, as its text view shows them; writes nothing | `decide` |
| `sla_calc` | Computes service-level downtime and percentages; reads and writes nothing | No agent |
